title: Why was my application denied?

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
You just came back from being banned since November. We, the Sr and mentor staff teams felt that you didn't have much recent community interaction.

Adding to that, you've never posted on the forums expect for when you created your application. 

Being around longer than most people doesn't make you the most involved. While we're happy you've stuck around this long and continue to keep playing on our servers, we're looking for people that have gotten into the community, and have taken that extra step from being an active player to an active community member.
